punchline: Midwest and California students were equally happy, but imagined peers were not.
thirty_sec: Among 1,993 students, overall life satisfaction was the same in the Midwest and California, yet students rating a similar person elsewhere expected Californians to be happier. The authors call this a focusing illusion.
question: How many hours of an ordinary Tuesday would the most striking difference change?
key_contrast: A big difference in imagination, a small one in daily life.
